plan.title: Tax ID Label by Business Location

steps.note: Open the buyer-side event screen that exposes the Participants and vendor invitation controls.
Open the participant controls so the vendor invitation drawer can be reached.
Confirm the Invite Vendor control is available.
Open the Invite Vendor side drawer.
Confirm the expected invitation method selector is visible.
Choose the Tax ID invitation method required by the case.
Set the business location to India.
Assert that India causes the Tax ID field to be labelled GSTIN.

args.goal: on the open Invite Vendor drawer, change Business Location from India to any available VAT country and stop with the Tax ID field visibly labelled VAT

steps.note: Discover and select a VAT country without inventing a country name, then leave the drawer showing the resulting Tax ID field.
Assert that the Tax ID field label changes to VAT for the selected VAT country.
